changelog: Initial release: Autonomous operator for Switchboard on-demand feeds, Surge streaming, and randomness across Solana/SVM, EVM, Sui, and more.
summary: Autonomous operator for Switchboard on-demand feeds, Surge streaming, and randomness. Designs jobs, simulates via Crossbar, and deploys/updates/reads feeds across Solana/SVM, EVM, Sui, and other Switchboard-supported chains—with user-controlled security, spend limits, and allow/deny lists.
